image_description: A close-up view of a car wheel featuring a five-spoke alloy rim with a two-tone finish (silver outer spokes and bright yellow inner accents). The rim is mounted with a black rubber tire showing visible tread patterns and sidewall texture. The central hub contains lug nuts and a center cap, with a brake caliper and rotor visible through the gaps in the spokes.

The background elements are heavily blurred/smudged, lacking coherent structure, which is common in AI generations focusing solely on the main subject.
